lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with the highest-intensity local maxima situated in the mid-lateral sector.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs to form a grid-like configuration along the lateral axis.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered near the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular notch present on the posterior trailing edge of the primary pectoral fin; minor high-luminance abrasion visible at the distal tip of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Abrupt morphological shift from high-density, low-diameter spot clusters on the cephalic region to lower-density, high-diameter clusters posterior to the final gill slit.
